correctness.rationale: Cyclic uniform-rank representation reduces every covariance to exact 3-,4-,or5-point relative order counts: A0=2/9,A±1=-1/9,A±2=1/45 and B0=-1/9,B±1=7/72,B±2=-7/360. A direct unitary DFT yields the two polynomial spectral bands in RESULT.md. The plus band is bounded below by 4/45; the minus band factors (1-c)(3-2c)/12 and vanishes only at c=1 (j=0). Both bands are strictly decreasing in c, giving the exact n=5 versus n>=6 minimum and alternating-frequency maximum. Taylor expansion of 1-cos(2pi/n) gives kappa/n²→5/pi². The bundled standalone Python 3 checker enumerates exact covariance entries at n=5..8 and performs 1964 assertions; infinite claims rest on the stated proof, not the tests. No unproved special lemma or excluded small n is silently used.

value.rationale: The cyclic peak-and-valley indicators are a canonical dual-channel rank-observation model. Their exact number-balance conservation produces a singular DC mode; the theorem quantifies the nearest nonzero harmonic sensitivity and proves a sharp n² condition growth with coefficient 5/pi², whereas the peak-only covariance stays full rank with limiting condition 11. This strict contrast and the complete all-n rank/condition threshold supply motivated harmonic observability information beyond local moment enumeration or a routine rename.
